text: I want a peachy, rosy perfume with a soft musky drydown. Nothing dirty or animalic.

hints.start: Read what she wants: rose at the heart, a touch of peach, a soft musky drydown, and nothing animalic. Only three bottles fit. Tap Rose absolute.
hints.rose: Rose is the heart of this one. Around ten drops. Tap the beaker for one drop, or hold to pour.
hints.peach: Peach is loud. Two drops, no more.
hints.ambrette: Ambrette is shy. It takes many drops to be heard.
hints.blotter: Test it on a blotter before you sell. She'll tell you what's missing.

text: Something fresh and lemony for after the gym, a touch of lavender, and a clean woody finish. Not too sweet.

hints.start: Fresh requests live in the top notes: lemon, bergamot, lavender. And he said not too sweet.

text: Something romantic: rose, a peachy glow, and a soft sweet base. Nothing dirty or animalic.
